title: Beginner Upper/Lower(1.0)
author: James K.
desc:
general bodybuilding. the exercises can be switched out with different variations and the total volume is low on purpose to give room to add more in later weeks if necessary.



this is a rough draft

ex.note:
Flat or 30 degree incline bench
tuck in elbows 45 degrees-ish to keep shoulders safe
do seated with back support at a 60ish degree angle not completely vertical

overhand grip and wider than shoulder width(unless its painful on your shoulders)
pull just below chin no further

Underhand if threes no neutral attachment
pull just below chin no further
let your upper back/shoulder blades round forward at the bottom. look up video
V-bar or rope(V-bar may be uncomfortable)
raise arms up and slightly in front of you. not straight up at the side. slightly bent elbows
dumbbell OR EZ bar
start with body weight. hold one dumbbell. balance with your free hand if instability is the limiting factor.
Skip if you dont have the machine. dumbbell leg curls suck butt

be warmed up first, knees will thank you
lean back in the seat slightly if you can
Look up form videos. can be tricky to do well.
stand on a ledge so your heel sinks below your toe(like on a staircase or something)

wall pushups->Elevated pushups->knee pushups->normal pushups->
when one variation gets easy move on to the next
do seated with back support at a 60ish degree angle not completely vertical

Loop Resistance Band over the pull up bar to make it easier, use thinner bands over time to make it more challenging. OR assisted pull up machine if you got one
over or underhand(personal pref)
use weight bench to lean/kneel on
raise arms up and slightly in front of you. not straight up at the side. slightly bent elbows
dumbbell OR EZ bar
V-bar or rope(V-bar may be uncomfortable)
elevate your heels(squat shoes/heel wedge or stand on small plates) squat deep as you can safely
Look up form videos. can be tricky to do well

be warmed up first, knees will thank you
lean back in the seat slightly if you can
Skip if you dont have the machine. dumbbell leg curls suck butt
stand on a ledge so your heel sinks below your toe(like on a staircase or something)
